units.source_text: 一个胖墩墩的肌肤白皙的女人——她的躯体轮廓像是融化了再挤出来似的——眯缝着一双似有似无的细眼睛在凝望着我。

en.t: A plump, fair-skinned woman, whose bodily outline looked as if it had melted and then been squeezed out again, was gazing at me through a pair of narrow eyes that seemed barely there.
I explained that I had come because I wanted to stay the night.

units.source_text: 她连声"请跟我来"也没有说，就默默地转过身子，向旅馆门厅走去了。

en.t: Without even saying, "Please come with me," she silently turned around and walked toward the inn's entrance hall.
